title: Add a batching helper for the events pipeline
description: The ingest worker processes events in fixed-size batches. This adds a shared `chunk` helper plus a small `walk` utility used to fan a range of indexes out to a callback.

expected.note: Array.prototype.slice's end index is exclusive, so `i + size - 1` drops the last item of every batch. Each batch processes one element too few and the final item of the list is never included; the end index should be `i + size`.
The while loop never advances `i`, so `walk` spins forever and hangs the worker the moment it is called with a non-empty range. Add `i += 1;` inside the loop body.
